annotations.title: Live jobs that fit a teacher

description: Live school vacancies ranked for one teacher's profile — for "here is my CV, what is live now that fits me?". Send only profile fields drawn from the CV or conversation (subjects, phases, curricula, role level, places, pay floor, right to work); do not send the CV text, names or contact details. Returns up to 25 jobs with the school, place, pay as published, closing date, a link, why each was matched and what to check. Matching is approximate: only place, phase, role level and a clearly different subject in the job title exclude a job, so read the results against the full CV before recommending them.

cities.description: Preferred cities or towns (ranks, does not exclude).

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 codes where the teacher would work, e.g. ["ae", "qa"]. Empty = anywhere.

hours.description: Hours wanted: part_time returns only part-time posts (incl. flexible, 0.x FTE, days per week, job share), with posts that fit but for their hours listed apart; full_time ranks part-time posts last.

include_org.description: true to also list posts at education organisations (exam boards, learned societies, education charities, edtech, school groups' head offices), as a separate group.

include_support.description: true to include support and administrative roles.

near_place.description: A place to be near, e.g. "central London", "Zone 1", "central Manchester", or a town. "Central …" means within 5 km unless radius_km is given.

part_time_ok.description: false to leave out part-time posts.

phases.description: Phases or levels, e.g. ["secondary", "sixth form", "IB Diploma", "EYFS", "KS2"].

radius_km.description: With near_place: leave out posts further than this many km.

regions.description: Broader regions instead of, or as well as, countries.

right_to_work.description: Countries (alpha-2) where the teacher already has the right to work or teacher registration.

roles.description: Role levels wanted, e.g. ["classroom teacher", "head of department", "deputy head"].

salary_currency.description: ISO-4217 currency of min_salary, e.g. GBP, AED.

sector.description: Where to look: school posts, university posts (lecturer, professor, dean, education faculty), organisations (UNESCO, UNICEF and similar), or any. Left out, roles such as lecturer or professor mean university.

subjects.description: Subjects taught, e.g. ["Physics", "General Science"]. Empty for non-subject roles. A subject outside the school list (e.g. "Education") is read as a field.

topics.description: Fields and interests beyond school subjects, especially for university posts: e.g. ["teacher education", "AI in education", "educational leadership", "curriculum"]. A post whose title or advert names one ranks higher.
